name: Reira Commerce Builder for Elementor
author: reirobinsingh

sections.description:
Reira Commerce Builder for Elementor is a WooCommerce Elementor addon created for store owners, designers and developers who want more control over WooCommerce layouts without writing custom template code.

Use this Elementor addon to build custom WooCommerce product pages, shop pages, category archive layouts, cart pages, checkout sections, My Account pages, product grids, menu carts and payment button areas directly inside the Elementor editor.

Instead of being limited to your theme’s default WooCommerce templates, Reira Commerce Builder for Elementor adds a dedicated collection of WooCommerce widgets to Elementor so you can design store pages visually and keep WooCommerce functionality intact.

Why use Reira Commerce Builder for Elementor?

  • WooCommerce Elementor addon for product, shop, cart, checkout and account layouts.
  • Works with Elementor Free — no Elementor Pro license is required for the included widgets.
  • Built for WooCommerce stores — uses WooCommerce template functions, product data and cart behavior.
  • Single product page builder widgets — title, images, price, rating, stock, add to cart, tabs, meta and short description.
  • Shop archive builder widgets — archive title, description and product loop widgets for shop/category pages.
  • Cart and checkout widgets — style cart, checkout, notices, menu cart and purchase summary sections.
  • Product grid widgets — display products, related products, upsells and categories in Elementor layouts.
  • Live Elementor preview support — product widgets can show sample product data while editing.
  • Lightweight frontend output — assets are loaded only where needed.
  • Theme friendly — works with WooCommerce-ready themes that follow WordPress and WooCommerce standards.

Best for

  • Creating a custom WooCommerce product page with Elementor.
  • Designing a WooCommerce shop archive page without editing PHP templates.
  • Adding WooCommerce widgets to Elementor Free.
  • Creating product grids, related products and category showcase sections.
  • Building custom cart and checkout page layouts.
  • Adding a menu cart widget with live cart count.
  • Improving product page design for fashion, digital downloads, accessories, services, marketplaces and general online stores.

Elementor Widget Category

After activation, the widgets appear in the Elementor editor under the Commerce Builder Widgets category.

Included WooCommerce Elementor Widgets

Single Product Widgets

  • Product Title — Display and style the WooCommerce product name.
  • Product Images — Show product gallery images with WooCommerce gallery output.
  • Product Price — Display regular, sale and current product prices.
  • Add to Cart — Add WooCommerce add-to-cart button and quantity control.
  • Product Rating — Show product star rating and review count.
  • Product Stock — Display stock availability and product status.

Product Data Widgets

  • Product Meta — Show SKU, categories and tags.
  • Short Description — Display the WooCommerce short description in Elementor.
  • Product Tabs — Show description, additional information and reviews tabs.
  • Additional Information — Display product attributes, dimensions and product information.

Product List Widgets

  • Products Grid — Create a WooCommerce product grid in Elementor.
  • Related Products — Display related products from WooCommerce.
  • Upsells — Show upsell products configured in product settings.
  • Product Categories — Display WooCommerce product categories with images and counts.

Shop and Archive Widgets

  • Archive Products — Show the main WooCommerce product loop.
  • Archive Title — Display dynamic shop/category archive titles.
  • Archive Description — Show WooCommerce category/archive descriptions.

Cart and Checkout Widgets

  • Cart — Display the WooCommerce cart table, coupons and totals.
  • Checkout — Add the WooCommerce checkout form to an Elementor layout.
  • Menu Cart — Add an icon cart with AJAX cart count and subtotal.
  • WC Notices — Show WooCommerce success, error and information notices.
  • PayPal Button — Add a PayPal payment button widget.
  • Stripe Button — Add a Stripe payment button widget.

Account Widgets

  • My Account — Display the WooCommerce My Account area.
  • Purchase Summary — Show customer purchase and order summary information.

Common use cases

WooCommerce single product page builder
Build a custom product detail page using Elementor widgets for product images, title, price, short description, add to cart, product tabs, attributes and stock status.

WooCommerce shop page builder
Create shop and category archive layouts using archive title, archive description and archive products widgets.

WooCommerce cart and checkout builder
Create branded cart and checkout page sections while keeping WooCommerce checkout functionality active.

Elementor product grid builder
Display products, categories, related products and upsell products on landing pages, homepages and promotional layouts.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher.
  • PHP 7.4 or higher.
  • Elementor 3.0 or higher.
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher.

External Services

This plugin can load third-party payment SDKs when you use the included payment widgets. These services are only used when the related payment widget is added and configured.

Stripe

The Stripe Button widget loads Stripe.js from Stripe to display payment fields and confirm payments.

Data sent: When a customer uses the Stripe Button widget, payment-related data required to process the transaction may be sent to Stripe.

Service provider: Stripe, Inc.
Terms of Service: https://stripe.com/legal/ssa
Privacy Policy: https://stripe.com/privacy

PayPal

The PayPal Button widget loads the PayPal JavaScript SDK from PayPal to render PayPal checkout buttons and process payments.

Data sent: When a customer uses the PayPal Button widget, payment-related data required to process the transaction may be sent to PayPal.

Service provider: PayPal, Inc.
Terms of Service: https://www.paypal.com/webapps/mpp/ua/legalhub-full
Privacy Policy: https://www.paypal.com/us/legalhub/privacy-full
sections.installation:
Install from WordPress.org

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Reira Commerce Builder for Elementor.
  3. Click Install Now.
  4. Click Activate.
  5. Make sure Elementor and WooCommerce are also installed and active.

Manual upload

  1. Download the plugin .zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the .zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Open a page in Elementor and search for Commerce Builder Widgets.

FTP upload

  1. Extract the plugin .zip file.
  2. Upload the reira-commerce-builder-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Go to Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  4. Activate Reira Commerce Builder for Elementor.
sections.faq:
Is this an Elementor addon for WooCommerce?

Yes. Reira Commerce Builder for Elementor is a WooCommerce Elementor addon that adds store design widgets to the Elementor editor.

Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. The included widgets work with Elementor Free. Elementor Pro is not required for the included widget set.

Does this plugin replace WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce is required. This plugin adds Elementor widgets that display and style WooCommerce content.

Can I build a custom WooCommerce product page?

Yes. You can use product widgets such as Product Title, Product Images, Product Price, Add to Cart, Product Tabs, Product Meta, Short Description and Additional Information to design a custom product page layout.

Can I build a custom WooCommerce shop page?

Yes. You can use Archive Products, Archive Title and Archive Description widgets to create custom shop and product category archive layouts.

Does the plugin work with Elementor Free?

Yes. Reira Commerce Builder for Elementor works with Elementor Free and Elementor Pro.

Does it work with any WooCommerce theme?

It is designed to work with WooCommerce-ready themes that follow WordPress and WooCommerce coding standards.

Will the Menu Cart update without page reload?

Yes. The Menu Cart widget can update cart count and subtotal using AJAX.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with WooCommerce High Performance Order Storage because it uses WooCommerce APIs and template behavior.

Does this plugin use external services?

Only the Stripe and PayPal widgets load third-party payment SDKs when those payment widgets are used. Details are provided in the External Services section below.

Where can I get support?

You can use the WordPress.org support forum for this plugin or visit https://reirahulsharma.com/.
